summary: TotalEnergies SE filed a Form 6-K reporting its second-quarter 2026 financial results, recent business developments, and a capitalization table as of June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report under Rule 13a-16, with no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The document incorporates previously filed registration statements by reference but does not initiate or disclose a special situation. This is an ordinary earnings update for a foreign private issuer.
